attributes.action: Kick Argentina Out Of The World Cup For Cheating.
attributes.additional_details: See how Argentina are a bunch of cheaters? Lets get em gone.
attributes.background: Argentina have been cheating A LOT. Especially Messi. How was that not a foul when he literally had his arm around Bellinghams throat? Messi is known for cheating since 2022. If Argentina hadn't been cheating i bet you England would of won. Argentina don't deserve to be in the world cup.
